big_case.notes: Independent read, formed from the record and the outcome: a clean First Amendment student-speech vehicle (Tinker/Fraser boundary) on a nationally recognizable political slogan, with a published divided CA6 opinion, a call for a response, four cert-stage amici, and FIRE opposite Williams & Connolly. Real doctrinal stakes for every public-school student had it been granted, but incremental rather than structural, and it ended in a quiet denial with no noted dissent after one substantive conference. Disclosure: the predictors' big_case_score values sit in the staged prediction.json and were visible before this read was recorded; the number above is my own and was not adjusted toward them.
